lines.beaver: 안녕하세요, 지호 어머니. 다음 주 견학 들으셨어요?
lines.beaver_en: Hello, Jiho's mom. Did you hear about next week's field trip?
lines.beaver_roman: Annyeonghaseyo, Jiho eomeoni. Daeum ju gyeonhak deureusyeosseoyo?
lines.learner: 네, 담임 선생님이 알려 주셨어요. 박물관 견학이죠?
lines.en: Yes, the homeroom teacher told me. It's the museum trip, right?
lines.roman: Ne, damim seonsaengnimi allyeo jusyeosseoyo. Bangmulgwan gyeonhagijyo?

lines.beaver_en: Right. But they say education costs are going up again.
lines.learner: 정말요? 우리 학교는 사립이라 학비가 엄청나요.
lines.en: Really? Our school is private, so tuition is huge.
lines.roman: Jeongmallyo? Uri hakgyoneun saribira hakbiga eomcheongnayo.

lines.beaver_en: I know. Besides tuition, there are academy fees too.
lines.en: Education costs are exactly parents' biggest worry.

lines.beaver: 맞아요. 다음 달 행사에 학부모도 많이 오겠죠?
lines.beaver_en: True. Lots of parents will come to next month's event, right?
lines.beaver_roman: Majayo. Daeum dal haengsae hakbumodo mani ogetjyo?
lines.en: Yes, I heard the principal is coming too.

lines.beaver_en: Jiho is class president, so he helps prepare too, right?
lines.en: Yes, he's busy as class president. But he enjoys it.

lines.beaver_en: How is Jiho's school life these days?
lines.learner: 잘 지내요. 담임 선생님이 아이들을 정말 아끼세요.
lines.en: He's doing well. The homeroom teacher really cares for the kids.
lines.roman: Jal jinaeyo. Damim seonsaengnimi aideureul jeongmal akkiseyo.

lines.beaver_en: I heard that teacher has a great academic background too.
lines.learner: 네, 학력도 좋고 그분이야말로 좋은 선생님이에요.
lines.en: Yes, great background, and she's truly a good teacher.
lines.roman: Ne, hangnyeokdo joko geubuniyamallo joeun seonsaengnimieyo.

lines.beaver: 요즘 반에 새로 온 분 있다던데요?
lines.beaver_en: I heard someone new came to the class lately?
lines.beaver_roman: Yojeum bane saero on bun itdadeondeyo?
lines.en: Yes, a student teacher has come.

lines.beaver_en: That's good. So when do we pay the field trip fee?
lines.learner: 이번 주 금요일까지예요. 담임 선생님께 내면 돼요.
lines.en: By this Friday. You can pay the homeroom teacher.
lines.roman: Ibeon ju geumyoilkkajiyeyo. Damim seonsaengnimkke naemyeon dwaeyo.

lines.beaver: 알려 줘서 고마워요. 행사 때 봬요.
lines.beaver_en: Thanks for letting me know. See you at the event.
lines.beaver_roman: Allyeo jwoseo gomawoyo. Haengsa ttae bwaeyo.
lines.en: Not at all. See you at the event, then!
